info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Mortgage Loans Apply-v1-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Application API allows users to apply for mortgage loans seamlessly and efficiently. This API is designed to facilitate the submission of mortgage applications by capturing essential information from potential borrowers. Typical consumers include financial institutions, lending platforms, and real estate agencies that require an integrated solution for handling loan applications. With this API, businesses can streamline their loan processing workflow and enhance customer service.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit an application for a loan by providing the necessary information. Ensure all required fields are completed to successfully process the application.

requestBody.description: Request body for applying for a loan, including all necessary details such as loan amount, duration, and applicant information.
